text.tspan: The atoms within 4.5 Å of the partner are the interface

svg.text: 105 atoms of 23 residues of HyHEL-10 Fab (blue) and 99 atoms of 21 residues
of lysozyme (orange); pale: seen through the surface.

text.tspan: A plane is laid through them; its long axis is the spine

svg.text: The atoms lie 2.7 Å off the plane, 7.9 Å along the spine and 5.1 Å across it
(root mean squares). The book opens about the spine, a quarter turn each.
from the side: the plane is a line
face on: the plane is the page

text.tspan: Two residues that touch make a point

svg.text: 49 pairs of residues have atoms within 4 Å of each other. The point of a pair
is the middle of its two residues on the plane (face on, the spine upright).

text.tspan: The points are put into groups

svg.text: 44 residues / 2 partners / 6 to a group = 3.7: 4 groups (2 at least, 6 at most).
A point goes to the nearest middle, a middle to the mean of its points (k-means).

text.tspan: A residue goes to the group that holds most of its pairs: the regions of the two faces

svg.text: Tyr333 of HyHEL-10 Fab has 5 pairs, 3 in II and 2 in I: it is of II. 4 of the 44 residues have no pair and go to the nearest middle.
The regions are numbered down the spine; 39 of the 49 pairs lie inside one region, 10 reach into another.
